mapper.select:
select IFNULL(sum(amount),0)
from bill
where user_id=#{userId}
and type=2
and DATE_FORMAT( bill_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m' )

select IFNULL(sum(amount),0)
from bill
where user_id=#{userId}
and type=1
and DATE_FORMAT( bill_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m' )

select
c.name,
sum(b.amount) value
from bill b
left join category c
on b.category_id=c.id
where b.user_id=#{userId}
and b.type=1
group by c.name

select
DATE_FORMAT( bill_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) date,
sum(amount) amount
from bill
where user_id=#{userId}
and type=1
and bill_time >= DATE_SUB( CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY )
group by bill_time
order by bill_time
